title: Why can't I cut this shirt in half?
content:
I have a T-shirt pattern that I've had for about a year, modified it many times for different uses. I opened it today, cut it down center front, and my workspace went black. I closed, opened and tried again. This time my workspace froze when I tried to apply symmetric pattern with sewing. Now I'm back to this pattern just turning my workspace black when I cut it. I installed the 2025.2 update for knit editing and auto pants patterns today. Don't know if that's related. 


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. It looks like a member of our team has responded to the ticket that you sent in earlier. In future we do recommend adding images for support so our team can see what the issue is and how to possibly best assist

title: Transform Graphic Issues
content:
Hello, I am trying to move a graphic placement by inputting values in to the 2D Measurements -> To Outline -> Right and Down measurements. I try to type in a value but when I press enter some other value comes up not what I typed in. Any ideas what's happening here? How can I place my graphic in a precise spot and then do the same on a paired piece? Thanks.![c6e919c01ecf41598267dddd9700411e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/7ef156f273924a6c82962bcf5b9df580/images/c6e919c01ecf41598267dddd9700411eCLO%20graphic.PNG)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Melody, thanks. I have just downloaded the latest version but I can't see the settings menu. Can you let me know where it is? Thank you.
Reply 1: Hi, it's being cut off due to the low resolution settings of your screen. If you want to keep the resolution as is, you can access the hidden parts of the menu through this faint arrow that I've circled on the screenshot.

Comment 2: Hi, it's working fine for me (measurements in mm). Can you please confirm your current version (bottom left corner of the CLO window with all numbers) and what measurement system you have CLO set to? (E.g. there was once a bug that only affected inches, so I want to make sure I'm replicating your scenario.)
Reply 1: Hi Melody, I am using the below version. I can't for the life of me see where I can get to the user settings to check the measurements but I am pretty sure it's in mm. Thanks for your help!
Reply 2: Hi, please upgrade to the latest version and see if it still occurs: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/7ef156f273924a6c82962bcf5b9df580 You can find the unit system under Settings --> User Settings --> User Interface --> Unit System.
Reply 3: The update seemed to help this feature work for me know. Thanks.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide troubleshooting tips and solutions for users experiencing issues with adjusting graphic placements using 2D measurements in design software.

Thanks![06673aa9e0ad469d8a17e35b633c6e4a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/731ab38a39e549da87a6740dafb6b12f/images/06673aa9e0ad469d8a17e35b633c6e4aScreenshot%202025-12-02%20171309.png)![8469fda5aa194a51b2a3340c2a0fb072](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/731ab38a39e549da87a6740dafb6b12f/images/8469fda5aa194a51b2a3340c2a0fb072Screenshot%202025-12-02%20173500.png)


### Community Post Comments:


Comment 2: Hi! Welcome to the software! It can be a little tricky at times, no worries, it’s all a process of learning the software. If the other comment suggestion didn’t work, I was going to suggest you use arrangement points again, get it situated where you want it, and resimulate.
